subject: date chooser not updating when date rolls over?

messages.author: 61903977a5f71cd9
messages.subject: date chooser not updating when date rolls over?
parts:
I have a date picker defined this way:

selectInput("date_picker", "Choose a date:",
               choices = seq.Date(Sys.Date()-10,Sys.Date()-1,1),selected=as.character(Sys.Date()-1)),

The app had been running since yesterday (2012-11-16, where the max date used for  'choices' or 'selected' would be 2012-11-15), and a page refresh today did not update the 'choices' or 'selected' dates to include 2012-11-16.  Stopping and restarting the app did, however.  Is this expected?  Can i do something to fix it?

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: date chooser not updating when date rolls over?
parts: Interesting. Right now Shiny only runs ui.R once when the app is first loaded (and will re-run if it detects that ui.R has changed); it caches the HTML tree after that. I'll have to think a bit about how to allow for this kind of scenario... perhaps shinyUI can take a cache=FALSE option? Hmmm...
